page.overview:
Who is Armed Dragon LV10?

Armed Dragon LV10 is a character version of the card, "Armed Dragon LV10".

Armed Dragon LV10 appears in the video game, Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2007. It appears as a Level Five Limited Duelist and it challenges the player to only included LV monsters in the Deck. By beating it, the player gets closer to unlocking Level Six Limited Duelists and a new Booster Pack.

In World Championship 2007, Armed Dragon LV10 plays a LV Monster Deck titled, "Growth Period".
